My dear [Miss Mildmay](/person/996)
I am much obliged for your Essex dialect, which I will put in when I can.[^2] I am much afraid such things will soon only be fossils, and that we shall only hear new fashioned vulgarisms

yours truly

C M Yonge


[^2]: This was probably a contribution to MP, but has not been identified.
